incidents.summary: payments-api 502s after release 2.3
incidents.description: Card payments failing with HTTP 502 from payments-api immediately after deploying release 2.3. Logs: upstream timeout after 5000ms.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back to 2.2 via pipeline. Root cause: new retry config doubled upstream timeouts.

incidents.summary: Checkout errors spike after payments-api 2.4 deploy
incidents.description: Error rate jumped to 18% within 10 minutes of 2.4 going live. Logs: 502 Bad Gateway, upstream connect error.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back to 2.3. Cause: connection pool size reduced in a config refactor PR.

incidents.summary: payments-api returning 503 after 2.6 rollout
incidents.description: 503 Service Unavailable on /v1/charges; pods crash-looping right after the deploy. Error: OOMKilled.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back to 2.5. Memory limit raised in a follow-up PR before redeploying.

incidents.summary: Failed card authorizations following release 2.7
incidents.description: Authorizations failing with HTTP 502 and 'upstream request timeout' right after the 2.7 deploy.
incidents.resolution: Reverted release 2.7 via pipeline rollback. Timeout was misconfigured in the release PR.

incidents.summary: payments-api 5xx after 2.9 hotfix deploy
incidents.description: Hotfix 2.9 introduced 502s on the refund endpoint. Logs: upstream timeout, retries exhausted.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back to 2.8.1 and fixed the retry budget before re-releasing.

incidents.summary: Spike in 502 Bad Gateway from payments-api after release 2.11
incidents.description: 502 Bad Gateway on /v1/charges for about 25% of requests after release 2.11. Upstream timeout to the PayRail client wrapper.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back to 2.10. Root cause: TLS client config change in the PayRail SDK wrapper PR.

incidents.summary: payments-api latency and 502s after deploy of 2.12
incidents.description: p99 latency went from 300ms to 9s after 2.12, followed by 502s. Database query count per request tripled.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back to 2.11. Cause: N+1 query introduced in the ledger lookup.

incidents.summary: Card payments failing after payments-api 2.13 release
incidents.description: HTTP 502 for about 30% of card payments after release 2.13. Logs show upstream timeout to the ledger service.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back to 2.12 per the rollback runbook. Cause: retry and timeout settings changed in the release PR.

incidents.summary: ledger-db: too many connections
incidents.description: Ledger writes failing. Error: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already. p99 latency 8s.
incidents.resolution: Killed idle-in-transaction sessions and raised the max pool size from 50 to 80.

incidents.summary: Connection pool timeout on ledger-db during month-end batch
incidents.description: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. Month-end reconciliation batch running.
incidents.resolution: Paused the batch job and terminated long-running reconciliation queries.

incidents.summary: Ledger API slow, DB connections exhausted
incidents.description: Ledger API timeouts; connection count pinned at the limit. Pool timeout errors in ledger service logs.
incidents.resolution: Found leaked connections from the reporting job; restarted the job and patched the leak.

incidents.summary: ledger-db max_connections reached after traffic spike
incidents.description: Promo traffic doubled request volume; ledger-db hit max_connections. Error: too many connections.
incidents.resolution: Scaled pgbouncer and raised the pool size.

incidents.summary: Payments stuck pending: ledger-db pool exhausted
incidents.description: Payments stuck in PENDING; ledger writes waiting on connections. Pool timeout after 30s.
incidents.resolution: Killed long queries from an analytics job misrouted to the primary instead of the replica.

incidents.summary: Pool timeout errors from ledger-db at peak
incidents.description: Intermittent pool timeout errors at evening peak. Connection is not available, request timed out.
incidents.resolution: Raised pool size and added a 30s statement timeout.

incidents.summary: ledger-db: remaining connection slots are reserved
incidents.description: Error: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections. Ledger writes failing.
incidents.resolution: Terminated idle connections and fixed a connection leak in the batch worker.

incidents.summary: Ledger write latency spike, too many connections
incidents.description: Ledger write latency at 6s; too many connections on ledger-db during a reindex.
incidents.resolution: Killed long queries per the connection exhaustion runbook and raised the pool.

incidents.summary: auth-gateway: certificate has expired
incidents.description: All logins failing. Error: SSL handshake failed: certificate has expired (CN=auth.northwindpay.example).
incidents.resolution: Rotated the certificate from the vault and restarted the gateway.

incidents.summary: SSL handshake failures to auth-gateway from mobile app
incidents.description: Mobile app logins failing with SSL handshake failed; web works. Started after a cert rotation.
incidents.resolution: Intermediate certificate missing after rotation; reinstalled the full chain.

incidents.summary: Partner API calls failing: x509 certificate expired
incidents.description: Partner integrations getting x509: certificate has expired from auth-gateway mTLS endpoint.
incidents.resolution: Renewed the mTLS client certificate and restarted gateway pods.

incidents.summary: auth-gateway TLS errors after cert renewal
incidents.description: Certificate verify failed for some clients right after renewal. Hostname mismatch in logs.
incidents.resolution: New certificate had the wrong SAN; reissued and redeployed.

incidents.summary: Logins failing with certificate verify failed
incidents.description: Login and token refresh failing: certificate verify failed, certificate has expired.
incidents.resolution: Rotated the expired certificate and added an expiry alert at 14 days.

incidents.summary: auth-gateway handshake errors, cert expired after sync
incidents.description: SSL handshake failed on auth-gateway after a config sync copied an old certificate to production.
incidents.resolution: Rotated the certificate per the auth-gateway certificate runbook.

incidents.summary: Payment receipt emails delayed 40+ minutes
incidents.description: notifications-worker consumer lag at 120k messages on topic payment-events. Receipts delayed.
incidents.resolution: Scaled consumers from 3 to 8; lag cleared in 25 minutes.

incidents.summary: notifications-worker stuck in rebalance loop
incidents.description: Consumer group rebalancing every few seconds; no messages processed. Logs: rebalance in progress, commit failed.
incidents.resolution: Increased max.poll.interval.ms and restarted the consumer group.

incidents.summary: Consumer lag on payment-events topic, SMS alerts delayed
incidents.description: Lag growing on a single partition of payment-events; SMS payment alerts delayed.
incidents.resolution: Cleared stuck partition 7 by moving a poison message to the DLQ.

incidents.summary: Receipt emails not sending, consumer lag growing
incidents.description: No receipt emails for 30 minutes; consumer lag growing steadily on payment-events.
incidents.resolution: Scaled consumers and skipped a poison message.

incidents.summary: notifications-worker lag after broker restart
incidents.description: After a scheduled broker restart, consumer lag spiked and partitions were unevenly assigned.
incidents.resolution: Rebalanced partitions and restarted workers.

incidents.summary: Delayed refund notifications, consumer lag 300k
incidents.description: Refund notifications delayed hours; consumer lag at 300k. Template rendering slow in worker logs.
incidents.resolution: Scaled consumers to 12 and fixed slow template rendering.

incidents.summary: Email backlog: notifications-worker rebalance storm
incidents.description: Repeated consumer rebalances causing an email backlog. Session timeouts in logs.
incidents.resolution: Raised the consumer session timeout and restarted the group.

incidents.summary: Card payments failing: PayRail timeout
incidents.description: ETIMEDOUT calling PayRail /authorize; about 40% of card payments failing.
incidents.resolution: Enabled failover to the backup provider for 2 hours until PayRail recovered.

incidents.summary: checkout-web shows payment failed: PayRail 504s
incidents.description: Customers see 'payment failed' at checkout. PayRail returning 504 Gateway Timeout.
incidents.resolution: Switched traffic to the failover provider; PayRail confirmed an incident on their side.

incidents.summary: PayRail authorize latency over 10 seconds
incidents.description: PayRail /authorize latency above 10s; payments-api threads saturated waiting on PayRail.
incidents.resolution: Lowered the PayRail timeout and enabled failover.

incidents.summary: PayRail ETIMEDOUT errors during peak
incidents.description: ETIMEDOUT and connection reset errors to PayRail during evening peak; card payments declining.
incidents.resolution: Enabled failover manually and asked PayRail for an RCA.

incidents.summary: Checkout failures, PayRail gateway timeout
incidents.description: Checkout failing for card payments; PayRail gateway timeout in payments-api logs.
incidents.resolution: Enabled the failover provider flag.

incidents.summary: PayRail timeouts causing declined payments
incidents.description: Declines spiking; PayRail timeout errors on /authorize and /capture.
incidents.resolution: Enabled failover. Documented the steps in this ticket because there is no runbook yet.

incidents.summary: Typo on checkout confirmation page
incidents.description: Confirmation page says 'Your payement is complete'.
incidents.resolution: Fixed the copy and redeployed checkout-web.

incidents.summary: DNS resolution blip for internal service discovery
incidents.description: Brief NXDOMAIN errors resolving internal service names for about 4 minutes.
incidents.resolution: Transient issue at the DNS provider; no action needed beyond monitoring.

incidents.summary: Disk usage alert at 85% on ledger-db replica
incidents.description: Disk usage alert on the ledger-db read replica.
incidents.resolution: Cleaned up old WAL archives and adjusted retention.

incidents.summary: Checkout button misaligned on Safari
incidents.description: Pay button overlaps the total on Safari 17.
incidents.resolution: CSS fix shipped in checkout-web.

incidents.summary: Wrong currency symbol in receipt email for CAD
incidents.description: Receipt emails for CAD payments show $ instead of CA$.
incidents.resolution: Fixed the currency formatting in the receipt template.

incidents.summary: Cloud quota alert: approaching vCPU limit
incidents.description: Quota alert at 90% of the regional vCPU limit for the payments cluster.
incidents.resolution: Requested a quota increase and removed unused node pools.

incidents.summary: Password reset link expires too quickly
incidents.description: Users report reset links expiring after 5 minutes instead of 30.
incidents.resolution: Corrected the token TTL config.

incidents.summary: Nightly backup job took longer than SLA
incidents.description: Nightly ledger-db backup ran 3h 40m against a 3h SLA.
incidents.resolution: Moved the backup window and enabled parallel dump.
